items.titleZh: F1荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛排位赛：拉塞尔力压诺里斯夺得杆位
items.summaryZh: 在荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛排位赛中，梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔以0.041秒的微弱优势击败卫冕世界冠军兰多·诺里斯，夺得杆位，这是他继上海站之后本赛季第二个冲刺赛杆位。F1冠军领跑者基米·安东内利仅列第五。

detailZh: F1荷兰大奖赛：乔治·拉塞尔在兰多·诺里斯之前夺得紧张的冲刺赛杆位
正在努力挽救自己F1 2026冠军争夺战的拉塞尔，在赞德沃特拿下了他本赛季的第三个冲刺赛杆位
乔治·拉塞尔夺得了荷兰大奖赛冲刺赛的杆位，而F1锦标赛领先者基米·安东内利仅排在第五位。
这位梅赛德斯车手仅以0.041秒的优势险胜卫冕世界冠军兰多·诺里斯，继第二站上海站之后，拿下了他2026赛季的第二个冲刺赛杆位。
拉塞尔的杆位尤其令人意外，因为他在SQ1和SQ2中都不是最快——这两个阶段分别由勒克莱尔和皮亚斯特里占据头名——但他在最后一个阶段的1分11.567秒已经足够快了。
最后一个阶段的争夺也非常激烈，因为排名第三的Leclerc为法拉利仅落后0.055秒，而Norris在迈凯伦的队友Piastri位列第四，落后拉塞尔0.099秒。
接下来与拉塞尔的队友Antonelli的差距则稍大一些，这位车手落后英国人0.227秒，并且因为在SQ1中在倒数第二个弯角冲出赛道而遭受了底盘损坏。
红牛的维斯塔潘恰好落后Antonelli十分之三秒，排名第六，比排名第七的汉密尔顿高一位，后者在另一辆法拉利中表现挣扎，与拉塞尔的差距为0.624秒。
阿尔派车队的加斯利、奥迪车队的博托莱托以及小红牛的新秀Arvid Lindblad分别在赞德沃特排在前十名的末尾，位次紧随周六的缩短赛程之后。
对劳森来说，这是一次相当体面的红牛回归——他已替代受伤的哈贾尔——尽管在排位赛中被他的老队友Lindblad淘汰，但他仍以第11名完赛。
“我完全不知道发生了什么，”这位新西兰车手报告说，他落后SQ3门槛十分之四秒，将与他的小红牛替补队友、重返F1的角田裕毅共同占据第六排发车。
科拉平托将在第13位发车，位于第七排，与他同排的是第14位的霍肯伯格，而奥康和阿尔本则分别位列SQ2淘汰区的最后两个位置。
在SQ1中，贝尔曼在最后时刻做出的提升成绩让他排在第17位，比威廉姆斯车手塞恩斯高一位，而Bearman的哈斯队友Ocon则将Sainz挤入了淘汰区。
阿隆索在冲刺排位赛中获得第22名。
最后四个位置被常客们占据：阿斯顿·马丁的斯特罗尔排在第19位，凯迪拉克组合Valtteri Bottas和Sergio Perez分列第20和第21位，阿隆索排在第22位。
Alonso的挣扎尤为明显，他在1号弯锁死了轮胎，尽管借助了凯迪拉克的尾流，仍然排名垫底，随后确认他的尾翼直线模式无法正常工作。
detailEn: F1 Dutch GP: George Russell clinches tight sprint pole ahead of Lando Norris
Russell, who is trying to save his F1 2026 title bid, took his third sprint pole of the season at Zandvoort
George Russell has taken pole position for the Dutch Grand Prix sprint race with Formula 1 championship leader Kimi Antonelli down in fifth.
The Mercedes driver pipped reigning world champion Lando Norris by only 0.041s to take his second sprint pole of the 2026 season after Shanghai at round two.
Russell’s pole came particularly out of the blue after topping neither SQ1 or SQ2 - respectively done by Charles Leclerc and Oscar Piastri - but a 1m11.567s in the final session was enough.
It was a very tight final session too, as third-placed Leclerc was just 0.055s off the pace for Ferrari with Norris’ McLaren team-mate Oscar Piastri in fourth and 0.099s behind Russell.
A slightly bigger gap then emerged to Russell’s team-mate Antonelli though, who was 0.227s behind the Briton and suffering floor damage from an off at the penultimate corner in SQ1.
Precisely three tenths behind Antonelli was Red Bull’s Max Verstappen in sixth, one spot ahead of seventh-placed Lewis Hamilton who struggled in the sister Ferrari with a 0.624s gap to Russell.
Alpine’s Pierre Gasly, Audi’s Gabriel Bortoleto and Racing Bulls rookie Arvid Lindblad respectively rounded out the top 10 at Zandvoort ahead of Saturday’s shortened race.
It was a respectable Red Bull return for Liam Lawson, who has replaced the injured Isack Hadjar, as he qualified 11th after being eliminated by his usual team-mate Lindblad.
“I have no idea what happened,” reported the New Zealander, who was four tenths off SQ3, and will share the sixth row with his Racing Bulls stand-in and F1 returnee Yuki Tsunoda.
Franco Colapinto will be on the seventh row in 13th, shared with 14th-placed Nico Hulkenberg, while Esteban Ocon and Alex Albon respectively rounded out the SQ2 drop zone.
In SQ1 a late improvement from Oliver Bearman put him 17th and one spot above Williams man Carlos Sainz, who was pushed into the elimination zone by Bearman’s Haas team-mate Ocon.
Fernando Alonso was 22nd in sprint qualifying
The last four spots were occupied by the usual suspects: Aston Martin’s Lance Stroll in 19th, Cadillac duo Valtteri Bottas and Sergio Perez 20th and 21st and Fernando Alonso in 22nd.
Alonso particularly struggled as he locked up at Turn 1 and finished last despite a tow from a Cadillac and it was later confirmed that the straight line mode on his rear wing didn’t work.

items.titleZh: 威廉姆斯曾担心同时失去塞恩斯和阿尔本，直至二人续约
items.summaryZh: 威廉姆斯车队负责人詹姆斯·沃尔斯承认，在车队2026赛季表现灾难性的情况下，他曾担心同时失去卡洛斯·塞恩斯和亚历克斯·阿尔本，所幸两位车手随后均选择续约。

items.originalTitle: 威廉姆斯曾担心同时失去塞恩斯和阿尔本，直至二人续约
items.summaryEn: Williams team principal James Vowles admitted he feared losing both Carlos Sainz and Alex Albon after the team's disastrous 2026 campaign, before both drivers committed their futures to the team.
detailZh: 在续约之前，威廉姆斯曾"担心同时失去"卡洛斯·塞恩斯（塞恩斯）和亚历克斯·阿尔本（阿尔本）
威廉姆斯F1车队负责人詹姆斯·沃尔斯坦承，他曾担心车队2026年的滑坡可能让他同时失去两名车手
亚历山大·阿尔本（Alexander Albon）、威廉姆斯、詹姆斯·沃尔斯（James Vowles）、威廉姆斯
威廉姆斯车队老板詹姆斯·沃尔斯承认，在塞恩斯和阿尔本两人续约明年的合同之前，车队灾难性的2026赛季曾让他担心同时失去他们。
威廉姆斯本周早些时候获得了一针强心剂，两位车手都承诺将继续留在这支陷入困境的车队。阿尔本续约至2027赛季，而塞恩斯签署了一份被称为'多年期'的续约合同，确保两位车手都留在格罗夫基地。
在2026年赛车项目遭遇灾难性失败、暴露出车队流程缺陷之后，车队排名跌至积分榜末尾，此时两位车手承诺其中期未来留在威廉姆斯，对车队员工来说是一剂急需的强心针。尤其是对车队领队沃尔斯而言，他当初曾在2025年费尽心思说服塞恩斯加入他的项目，这位四届大奖赛冠军得主与长期效力的车手阿尔本一起，成为他重建计划的基石。
但威廉姆斯2026年的挫折实在太严重，以至于沃尔斯真的担心自己可能在收获劳动成果之前就失去两位车手。
'我担心会同时失去他们两个，因为他们是具备世界冠军水准的车手，理应有机会去争夺领奖台甚至更好的成绩，'沃尔斯在赞德沃特承认。
“我们没有做到那一点。更重要的是，我们有一个关于未来发展方向的范围规划。我希望外界毫不怀疑，在过去几年里我们一直在稳步向前迈进，虽然去年是一个小失误——我认为那其实比我们的实际水平要积极——但方向是正确的。
“所以，对我们来说出现倒退，不仅让车手们感到意外，也让所有人都感到意外。这总会带来失去他们的风险。
“让我感激的是，当我们遇到问题时，他们站在了我们这一边。没有相互指责，而是‘告诉我我能做什么’。他们两人都来到工厂，与整个团队交流，并鼓舞了大家的士气。Carlos 这么做了，Alex 在本周续约之后也同样这么做了。”
随着 维斯塔潘 与 红牛 续约，以及其他顶级车队保持原有车手阵容，Sainz 或 Albon 想要获得平级调动以外的机会的空间十分有限。但 Vowles 坚信，两位车手都完全投入到了他在这支长期资金不足的车队所开启的长期项目中。
"他们希望这能成为他们的一部分，留在这个组织的转型期里。对此我很感激。但这也表明了，从事态发展的后半段来看，我们向他们展示了什么，以及我们正在为此采取什么行动。
"如果他们选择续约，这就说明正在进行大量的变革，他们对未来的样子充满信心。而这种信心极其重要，无论是对车队成员，还是对外界的任何人来说都是如此。
"这种稳定性很重要，因为车队正在真正地成熟和变化。而尽可能保持稳定，尤其是在你的车手阵容方面，这对于在此基础上继续发展变得至关重要。
Vowles表示，当双重续约的消息传达出去后，车队的工厂员工感到"如释重负"。虽然这为一支已经数月远离积分区的车队带来了可喜的士气提升，但这并不能减少前方依然存在的繁重工作。
威廉姆斯 实际上不得不摒弃许多陈旧的系统和流程，才能成为一支现代的 F1 一线车队。前 迈凯伦 成员 Piers Thynne 是几名关键新员工之一，与一些来自 Vowles 老 东家 梅赛德斯 的员工一起，负责监督这一转型。
威廉姆斯 上一次登上领奖台是 塞恩斯 在 2025 年卡塔尔大奖赛上。
在希望展示持续进步（包括下个月阿塞拜疆大奖赛带来的重大赛车升级）的同时，Vowles 明确表示，转型不会很快完成。“我们不可能在 12 个月内修好 威廉姆斯。那不可能发生。我们不可能在一年之内挖出并解决每一个问题。”
“不过，我们将确保我们做出的每一个决定，都是为了我们长期成功而做的正确决定。”Vowles 补充道。
“我们向Carlos展示的是今冬发生的一切，我们现在为解决这些问题正在做的一切，由此实现转变后的状态，以及未来的展望。
“这一点毫无疑问。我们远未达到我们想要的位置。我们有一辆超重、交付延迟且性能规格未达到我们期望的赛车。这些都是事实。Carlos想看到的，Alex也是一样，是我们正在做出的改变，这些改变向我们表明车队正处于正确的轨迹上。
“这是人员、流程、系统、结构多方面的结合，不是单一因素。这向他们表明我们正走在正确的道路上。
detailEn: Williams was "concerned about losing both" Carlos Sainz and Alex Albon before contract extensions
Williams Formula 1 chief James Vowles opens up on his fear the team's 2026 slump could have him cost him both of his drivers
Alexander Albon, Williams, James Vowles, Williams
Williams boss James Vowles admits the team's disastrous 2026 campaign made him worry about losing both Carlos Sainz and Alex Albon, before the pair re-signed for next year.

Williams received a shot in the arm earlier this week when both drivers pledged their future to the struggling outfit. Albon took up an extension for the 2027 season, while Sainz signed what was billed a "multi-year" contract extension to keep both drivers at Grove.

With the team languishing towards the back of the grid after a disastrous 2026 car project that exposed the team's procedural deficiencies, having both of its drivers commit their medium-term future to Williams was a much-needed boost for the team's staff. Not in the least for team principal Vowles, who had dug deep to convince Sainz to join his project in the first place in 2025, with the four-time grand prix winner becoming a cornerstone of his rebuild alongside long-time driver Albon.
But Williams' 2026 blip has been so severe that Vowles had genuine fears he could lose both drivers before reaping the rewards of his labour.
"[I was] concerned about losing both, because they are world championship material drivers that deserve the opportunity to be fighting for podiums or more," Vowles admitted in Zandvoort.

"We haven't delivered that. And more than that, we had a scope of where we were moving to. I hope there's no doubt in the outside world that over the last few years we've been slowly stepping forward with last year being a blip - I think too positive for where we were - but a step in the right direction.
"So, for us to move backwards isn't just a surprise to the drivers, it's a surprise to everyone. And that will always create risk that we lose them.

"What I'm thankful for is the moment we had problems, they stood by our side. It wasn't finger pointing, it was actually 'tell me what I can do'. And they both came into the factory, spoke to the whole organisation and gave them a lift. Carlos did the same and Alex did the same this week once they re-signed."

With Max Verstappen renewing his Red Bull deal and other top teams hanging on to their driver line-ups, any scope for either Sainz or Albon to make anything but a sideways move was limited. But Vowles was adamant that both drivers fully bought into the long-term project he has embarked on at what had long been an underfunded team.

"They want this to be a part of them that is here on a turnaround of this organisation. And I'm thankful for that. But it's also an indication of what we've shown them in the back end of what's happened and what we're doing about it.

"If they are re-signing, it will give you an indication that there's a lot of change ongoing, that they believe in what the future looks like. And that belief is incredibly important, whether it's for team members or for anyone in the outside world.

"That consistency is important because the team is really maturing and changing. And as much as you can keep consistent, especially in your driver line-up, it becomes desperately important in order to keep building on that."

Vowles said there was a "weight lifted" off the team's factory staff as news of the double renewal was communicated. But while it provided a welcome morale boost for a team that hasn't been anywhere near the points for months, that doesn't detract from the mountain of work that still lies ahead.

Williams effectively had to throw out a lot of its antiquated systems and procedures to become a modern frontline F1 operation. Former McLaren man Piers Thynne was one of several key hires made, alongside some of Vowles' former Mercedes staffers, to oversee that transition.
Williams last celebrated a podium with Carlos Sainz at the 2025 Qatar Grand Prix.

While hoping to show consistent progress, starting with a major car upgrade at next month's Azerbaijan Grand Prix, Vowles made it crystal clear that transformation won't be completed any time soon. "We're not going to fix Williams in 12 months. It's not going to happen. We're not going to dig out every single problem that's happened in one year.
"We will, however, make sure that every decision we're doing is the right one for our long-term success," Vowles added.

"What we demonstrated to Carlos is everything that happened this winter, everything that we are doing right now to fix it, the corner that we've turned as a result of it and what the future looks like.

"And there's zero doubt about it. We are way off where we wanted to be. We have a car that was overweight, late and not to the performance specification that we wanted it to be. So those are just facts. What Carlos wanted to see, and Alex for that matter as well, is the changes that we are making that show us that there's the right trajectory.
"It's a combination of people, processes, systems, structures. It's not one thing. And it shows them that we are on the right path."

items.originalTitle: 奥利弗·贝尔曼承认哈斯车队已沦为F1“第十强”
items.summaryEn: A downbeat Oliver Bearman has accepted that Haas is now the "10th best team" in Formula 1 after being overtaken by Aston Martin at the Hungarian Grand Prix.
detailZh: 奥利弗·贝尔曼表示，在阿斯顿·马丁升级后，哈斯在F1中倒退为“第十快的车队”。
哈斯在2026年F1赛季开局表现积极，但缺乏赛车升级导致其成绩下滑。
情绪低落的奥利弗·贝尔曼承认，在匈牙利大奖赛上被阿斯顿·马丁超越后，哈斯现在是F1中的“第十快车队”。
这支美国车队在2026年规则变更后开局强劲，在前六轮比赛中有五轮获得积分，但在过去五场大奖赛中未能得分。
因此车队现在在积分榜上勉强守住第七名，而缺乏持续的升级是导致其下滑的原因之一，它上一次的大升级包还是在五月的蒙特利站推出的。
这导致Bearman上一站布达佩斯在Q1便遭淘汰，而阿斯顿·马丁在该站带来了大量底盘升级，帮助阿隆索和斯特罗尔双双完赛名次都排在哈斯之前。
这支总部位于银石的车队本周末将在赞德沃特享用升级后的本田引擎，因此在对手不断升级的情况下，Bearman对哈斯在竞争格局中的位置感到悲观。
这位21岁的车手表示：“我们在前几场比赛的表现真的非常非常好，赛车速度很快，发挥出色，我们非常开心。但后来，别人一步一步追了上来，别人实现了超越，现在他们已经把我们彻底甩在身后了。”
“年初的时候，我们还能与[比赛 Bull]竞争，我们比他们更快。我记得在澳大利亚的比赛中超越了他们两辆车并甩开了他们，而如今我们想都不敢想这种事。
“所以，事情变化得这么快真是很有意思。2025年对我们来说确实是第一年，或者是极少数的几年之一，我们在整个赛季似乎都拥有不错的速度。
“实际上，随着赛季的推进，我们的相对表现有所提升，而现在的2026年更像是我们在过去看到的哈斯的样子：起步非常强势，有一辆非常快的车作为基础，但却无法像其他车队那样不断改进。
“坦率地说，我们目前已经被超越了。我们是第十快的车队。这真的让人心痛，对我本人和所有其他人来说都是如此。我们一直在非常努力地工作以避免出现这种情况，但这就是我们目前的现实。”
升级不足的原因可以归结为：私人车队哈斯（哈斯）的预算是围场中最小的，无法与梅赛德斯、法拉利甚至阿斯顿·马丁这样的厂商巨头相比。
自2016年首次参赛以来，这一问题一直制约着车队，但有时影响并不那么大——比如2025年，哈斯实际上随着赛季推进而不断进步，最终获得第八名。
奥利弗·比尔曼（贝尔曼），哈斯F1车队，卡洛斯·塞恩斯（塞恩斯），威廉姆斯车队
在规则周期末期，升级并不那么突出，而2026年情况恰恰相反——研发竞赛正是决定不断变化的名次格局的关键。
所以Bearman认为“这是哈斯车队最大的问题”，这位英国车手认为，尽管威廉姆斯等车队本赛季也很挣扎，但哈斯现在的排名仅高于新军凯迪拉克。
“事实是，我们无法像其他车队那样带来那么多的升级，”他补充道。“当我们升级赛车时，它是具有竞争力的、有效的，但当变化速度如此之快时，比如在一套新规则实施的初期，我们就跟不上节奏了。
“我们的开局方式表明，我们对赛车的基础平台理解得非常透彻，我们知道如何打造一辆快车，但我们没有足够的资源来持续升级赛车。
“如果其他车队每三场比赛就带来一次升级，我们只能每九场比赛升级一次，这样的速度是不够快的。
“去年我们可能没被发现，因为那是一套非常成熟的规则的最后一年。
"现在到了2026年，所有人都在更新赛车。我们对面的那帮家伙每三场比赛就带来一辆不同的车。太疯狂了。
“你看到从日本站到迈阿密站的红牛了吗？完全是另一辆车。我们做梦都不敢那么做，从来不敢。”
detailEn: Regressing Haas "10th best" in F1 after Aston Martin upgrades - Oliver Bearman
Haas started the 2026 F1 campaign positively, but a lack of car upgrades has contributed to its decline
A downbeat Oliver Bearman has accepted that Haas is now the “10th best team” in Formula 1 after being overtaken by Aston Martin at the Hungarian Grand Prix.
The American outfit started the 2026 regulation change strongly with points in five of the opening six rounds, but has failed to score in the past five grands prix.
So it is now clinging onto seventh in the championship and a lack of continuous upgrades has contributed to that decline with its last major package coming at Montreal in May.
It led to a Q1 exit last time out for Bearman in Budapest, where Aston Martin brought vast chassis upgrades that helped both Fernando Alonso and Lance Stroll finish above Haas.
The Silverstone squad will now enjoy an updated Honda engine at Zandvoort this weekend, so Bearman is pessimistic about Haas’ standing in the pecking order as rivals keep upgrading.

“We had a really, really good first few races where the car was quick, performing well, and we were really happy,” said the 21-year-old, “But then, step by step, others caught up, others overtook, and now they've left us totally behind.

“At the start of the year, we were fighting, we were quicker than [Racing Bull]. I remember overtaking both of them in the race in Australia and driving away, and we wouldn't dream of doing that these days.
“So, it's funny how quickly things change. 2025 was really the first year for us, or one of very few years, where we seemed to have good pace throughout the year.

“We actually improved our relative performance as the year went on, and now 2026 is more of what we've seen from Haas in the past, of starting incredibly strong with a really quick car as a base, but not being able to improve like the others have.

“Quite frankly, we've been overtaken right now. We are the 10th best team. It really hurts, myself and all the others. We were working really hard to make that not be the case, but that's the reality of where we are right now.”
A lack of upgrades can be attributed to the privateer Haas squad having the smallest budget on the grid compared to the factory juggernauts like Mercedes, Ferrari and even Aston Martin.
This is something that has held it back ever since its debut in 2016, but at times it hasn't mattered so much - such as 2025 when Haas actually improved as the season progressed to finish eighth.
Oliver Bearman, Haas F1 Team, Carlos Sainz, Williams
But upgrades weren’t so prominent at the end of a regulation cycle, whereas it is the opposite in 2026 with the development race being what decides the ever-evolving pecking order.
So Bearman reckons “that’s the biggest issue” for Haas, which the Briton thinks is now only above newcomer Cadillac despite squads like Williams also struggling this season.

“The fact is that we can't bring as many upgrades as the others,” he added. “When we do upgrade the car, it's competitive and it works, but when the rate of change is so fast, like at the start of a new set of regulations, we can't keep up.
“The way that we started shows that we understand the platform of the car very well, and we know how to make a fast car, but we don't have the resource to continually upgrade the car.
“If the others are putting on an upgrade every three races, we're only able to do it every nine races, and that's not quick enough.
“Last year, probably we didn't get found out, because it's the last year of a very mature set of regulations.
"Now we come to 2026, where everyone's updating the car. These guys opposite us are bringing a different car every three races. It's insane.
“Did you see the Red Bull from Japan to Miami? It was a different car. We couldn't dream of doing that, ever.”

但最近五场大奖赛均未能得分，升级不足导致竞争力下滑

items.originalTitle: 阿隆索：确认F1未来没有时间表
items.summaryEn: Fernando Alonso has confirmed there is no timeline on the decision regarding his Formula 1 future as he is still awaiting talks with Lawrence Stroll and Adrian Newey. The 45-year-old's Aston Martin contract expires at the end of the 2026 season, with talk of his possible retirement swirling.
detailZh: 费尔南多·阿隆索：确认F1未来尚无时间表
这位45岁车手的F1前景未知，他与阿斯顿·马丁的合同将于2026年到期
费尔南多·阿隆索已确认，关于其一级方程式未来的决定尚无时间表，因为他仍在等待与劳伦斯·斯特罗尔和阿德里安·纽维的会谈。
围绕2027年F1车手阵容将如何形成，这位45岁车手成为诸多疑问的焦点，随着他与阿斯顿·马丁的合同将于当前2026赛季末到期，关于他可能退役的传言四起。
阿隆索此前曾表示，他会在“夏季前后”做出决定，但随着本周末F1在八月停摆期后回归荷兰大奖赛，目前仍未有任何官方宣布。
当在赞德沃特被问及决定的新时间表时，这位西班牙车手回答道：“我没有任何时间表。我刚度假回来，所以接下来几天、几周或几个月再看吧。”
“我知道劳伦斯这个周末会来，所以我会和他共进一顿愉快的午餐或喝杯咖啡，也许在蒙扎[9月4-6日]，或者我不知道他下次什么时候来。”
“我很快也得去工厂做马德里模拟器的相关工作，所以如果劳伦斯或阿德里安在的话，我会和他们坐下来谈谈。也许就在接下来的几周内。”
阿德里安·纽维（Adrian Newey），阿斯顿·马丁车队，劳伦斯·斯特罗尔（Lawrence Stroll），阿斯顿·马丁
可以认为，阿斯顿·马丁的竞争力可能会在阿隆索是否继续留队的问题上发挥作用，因为这支车队在2026年至今表现不佳，只拿到了1个积分。
但局势可能正在好转，上一站布达佩斯的比赛见证了AMR26性能的提升，这得益于大规模的底盘升级，而赞德福特则标志着其竞争力不足的本田引擎迎来首次更新。
不过，阿隆索确认，即将到来的升级对于他的未来决定而言“并不重要”。
“我希望我们确实能在动力、驾驶性能以及我们之前欠缺的那些方面看到一些益处，”这位两届F1冠军补充道。
“但对我来说更重要的是，就像在布达佩斯时底盘方面那样，能看到大家对需求有一种共同的理解理念，并且向前迈出了一步。
“在布达佩斯，我们知道我们无法去争夺靠前的位置，但我们想确认底盘方面的方向是正确的，我认为我们做到了这一点。
“所以，这是对未来的一个鼓舞，说明相关性是好的，我们所预期的都得到了兑现，现在在引擎方面也是同样的道理。
"我认为他们对引擎做了一些改动，所以最好确认一下一切是否按预期运行。不管是快0.1秒还是1秒，数字本身其实并不重要。"
"我们已经落后太多了，不会真的在意一个数字。我们只想看到我们所期望的改进确实得到了落实。"
但如果阿隆索选择不续约，他仍将以某种身份继续留在阿斯顿·马丁，同时参加其他赛车锦标赛。
这位西班牙车手在F1之外也取得了成功，他曾赢下勒芒24小时耐力赛和世界耐力锦标赛，还参加过达喀尔拉力赛和印第安纳波利斯500大赛。
“无论以什么角色，长期来看我都会和这支车队在一起，”他说。“这不是关于我自己，也不是关于明年谁来开车，或者我明年还要不要开、再开三年。我不知道。
“和劳伦斯、阿德里安坐下来，根据车队的需要来决定是否由我来开车。我会考虑。如果我在另一个岗位上能更有价值，我也会感到高兴。
“但我需要驾驶点什么。这是肯定的。我需要比赛。我需要感受肾上腺素。我是一个竞争者。
“我心里有各种各样的挑战，就像我说过很多次的，有一天要赢得达喀尔拉力赛，或者再次尝试印地500，或者迎接接下来出现的任何挑战。
“当然，在一级方程式中赢得第三个世界冠军，那显然是终极梦想。
“这有可能实现吗？我不知道这支车队需要多长时间才能达到那样的表现。那会是非常漫长的时间。”
detailEn: Fernando Alonso: No timeframe on confirming F1 future
The 45-year-old's F1 future is unknown with his Aston Martin contract expiring in 2026
Fernando Alonso has confirmed there is no timeline on the decision regarding his Formula 1 future as he is still awaiting talks with Lawrence Stroll and Adrian Newey.

The 45-year-old is the subject of various questions surrounding how the 2027 F1 grid could shape up, with talk of his possible retirement swirling as his Aston Martin contract expires at the end of the current 2026 campaign.
Alonso previously stated that he would decide “around summer time”, but this weekend F1 returns from its August shutdown with the Dutch Grand Prix and no announcement has been made.
Qhen asked at Zandvoort for a new timeframe on his decision, the Spaniard replied: “I don't have any. I just came from holiday, so I will see in the next days or weeks or months.
“I know Lawrence is coming this weekend, so I will have a nice lunch with him or coffee and maybe Monza [4-6 September] or I don't know when he is coming next.
“I will have to go to the factory soon as well to do Madrid simulators, so maybe if Lawrence is around or Adrian, I will sit with them. So maybe in the next weeks.”
Adrian Newey, Aston Martin Racing, Lawrence Stroll, Aston Martin
It could be believed that Aston Martin’s competitiveness may play a role in whether Alonso continues or not, as the squad has been poor so far in 2026 and has scored just one point.
But the tide may be turning as Budapest last time out saw an improved AMR26 thanks to vast chassis upgrades and Zandvoort marks the first updates to its uncompetitive Honda engine.
Alonso, however, confirmed the forthcoming upgrades are “not important” for when it comes to his future decision.
“I hope we see some benefit for sure in terms of power, drivability and the things that we were missing,” the two-time F1 champion added.
“But for me it's more important, like in Budapest with the chassis side, to see that there is an understanding philosophy on what the needs are and a step forward.
“In Budapest, we knew that we would not compete for the top positions, but we wanted to check that the direction on the chassis side was the correct one and I think we did that.
“So, that's something that is encouraging for the future that the correlation is good and what we expected was delivered and now with the engine it's the same thing.
“I think they made some changes to the engine so it would be nice to confirm that everything is working as expected and if it's one tenth or one second it doesn't matter really, the number.
“We are too far behind to really care about a number. We just want to see that what we expected is delivered.”
But if Alonso opts against renewing his contract, he would still remain with Aston Martin in some capacity while also competing in other motorsport championships.
The Spaniard has enjoyed success outside of F1 by winning the Le Mans 24 Hours and World Endurance Championship, while also contesting Dakar and the Indianapolis 500.
“I will be with this team in one role or another for the long term,” he said. “It's not about myself or about who is driving next year, or if I am driving next year or three more years. I don't know.
“Sitting with Lawrence and Adrian and the needs for the team is for me to drive. I will consider. I will be happy if I can be more valuable in another position.
“But I need to drive something. That's something for sure. I need to race. I need to feel the adrenaline. I am a competitor.
“I have all the challenges in my head, as I said many times to win one day Dakar or to try again Indy 500 or whatever is coming next.
“Also winning in Formula 1 a third world championship, that will be obviously the ultimate dream.
“Is that possible? I don't know how long it will take to achieve that performance for this team. It's going to be a very long time.”
keyPointsZh: 阿隆索成为2027年F1车手阵容猜测的焦点。
keyPointsEn: Alonso is the subject of various questions surrounding how the 2027 F1 grid could shape up.

items.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在荷兰大奖赛唯一一次练习赛中以1分12秒949的最快圈击败兰多·诺里斯的迈凯伦，登顶圈速榜，开启2026赛季下半程。
items.originalTitle: 2026荷兰大奖赛唯一练习赛：安东内利力压诺里斯登顶
items.summaryEn: Kimi Antonelli topped the sole practice session at the Dutch Grand Prix with a 1m12.949s lap, beating Lando Norris's McLaren as the second half of the 2026 Formula 1 season began.
detailZh: 安东内利 为2026年F1赛季下半程拉开序幕并拔得头筹，在荷兰大奖赛练习赛中击败诺里斯的迈凯伦，占据榜首。
积分榜领跑者Antonelli在赞德沃特唯一一节练习赛的最后时刻做出了1分12.949秒的单圈，这是他在那套软胎上的第二个飞驰圈，此前他的第一个飞驰圈被慢车阻挡。
Antonelli在本节练习赛早些时候还曾在10号弯出口发生一次无害的打滑，随后恢复了练习。
Norris也在他的第二个飞驰圈上有所提升，最终落后Antonelli 0.121秒，拉塞尔排名第三，落后他的队友Antonelli 0.125秒。
刘易斯·汉密尔顿和夏尔·勒克莱尔的法拉利赛车分别排名第四和第五，但与最快圈速相差不到0.3秒。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里的迈凯伦排名第六，比安东内利的基准圈速慢了0.659秒。
尼科·霍肯伯格的奥迪以中性胎领跑中游集团排名第七，领先于皮埃尔·加斯利——后者的车上装上了阿尔派的重大升级件（弗朗哥·科拉平托将在蒙扎用上该升级）——以及霍肯伯格在奥迪车队的队友加布里埃尔·博托莱托。
阿尔维德·林德布拉德为小红牛车队排名第10，领先于刚刚重新承诺效力红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘。
这对红牛来说是艰难的一节练习赛，维斯塔潘在转向不足的问题上苦苦挣扎，而利亚姆·劳森则努力适应小红牛22——他直到本周初才得知自己将首次驾驶这款车。
劳森最终排在第14位，比维斯塔潘慢了大约0.6秒，他在最后一个飞驰圈于11/12号弯的减速弯出现了失误。
该路段也让卡洛斯·塞恩斯的威廉姆斯赛车吃了亏，他在赛道上出现了几次失误，最终排在第22位，为威廉姆斯垫底。
在其他方面，新的本田引擎升级包跑出了可观的里程数（49圈），并帮助阿隆索做出了第12快的成绩，比最快成绩慢了1.5秒。
而角田裕毅在为小红牛出战的他的首场F1比赛中获得第17名，此时距离他去年年底失去红牛车手席位已经过去了八个月。
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli kicked off the second half of Formula 1’s 2026 season on top, beating Lando Norris’s McLaren to the top spot in practice at the Dutch Grand Prix.

Championship leader Antonelli delivered a 1m12.949s lap in the dying moments of the sole practice session at Zandvoort, his second flying lap on those soft tyres after he was baulked by traffic on his first.
Antonelli also had a harmless spin earlier in the session on the exit of Turn 10 before resuming.
Norris also improved on his second flying lap to end up 0.121s adrift of Antonelli, with George Russell third, 0.125s off his team-mate Antonelli.
The Ferraris of Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc were fourth and fifth quickest but within three tenths of the pace.
Oscar Piastri’s McLaren was 0.659s slower than Antonelli’s benchmark in sixth.

Nico Hulkenberg’s Audi led the midfield in seventh on the medium tyres, ahead of Pierre Gasly, who has Alpine’s major upgrade on his car (Franco Colapinto will get it at Monza), and Hulkenberg's Audi team-mate Gabriel Bortoleto.
Arvid Lindblad was 10th for Racing Bulls, ahead of Max Verstappen, fresh from recommitting to Red Bull.

It was a tricky session for Red Bull, with Verstappen struggling with understeer and Liam Lawson trying to get to grips with the RB22 that he only found out he’d be driving for the first time earlier this week.
Lawson ended up 14th, around six tenths adrift of Verstappen, having had a moment at the Turn 11/12 chicane on his final flying lap.
That section also caught out Carlos Sainz’s Williams, which ended up 22nd and last for Williams, having had a couple of off-track moments.
Elsewhere, the new Honda engine upgrade racked up decent mileage (49 laps) and powered Alonso to the 12th fastest time, 1.5s off the pace.
And Yuki Tsunoda was 17th in his first F1 session for Racing Bulls, eight months on from losing his Red Bull drive at the end of last year.

车手们迅速驶出维修区参加这个冲刺周末的唯一一节练习赛——这也是赞德福特赛道向F1告别的时刻——在潮湿的海滨赛道上，中性胎是初始选择。
但赛道条件正在变干，尼科·霍肯伯格几乎立刻表示“我觉得该用干胎了”，因此很快就放弃了中性胎，奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在五分钟后就换上了中性胎。
这位迈凯伦车手以1分23秒311的成绩领跑，比使用中性胎最快的刘易斯·汉密尔顿快2.251秒，随后在下一圈将成绩提升至1分20秒480。
这种剧烈的提升预示着不断演变的赛道上将有更多变化，安东内利在最初三圈中先后跑出1分18秒264、1分16秒112和1分15秒531，飙升至榜首。
因此圈速不断下降，汉密尔顿、乔治·拉塞尔和夏尔·勒克莱尔都曾登上榜首，而安东内利在一小时练习赛进行到一半时也在10号弯经历了360度打转。“我不知道那里到底发生了什么，”这位梅赛德斯车手报告说。
当剩余10分钟软胎测试开始时，一切自然升级，皮亚斯特里率先以1分13秒608打破了勒克莱尔的中性胎标杆成绩（1分14秒146）。
不过皮亚斯特里没有领先太久，勒克莱尔以0.261秒的优势重新夺回榜首，随后法拉利队友汉密尔顿跑出1分13秒139，比他快0.208秒。

这对锦标赛领头羊来说已经足够，他以50分的优势领先第二名汉密尔顿，并保持榜首位置，因为诺里斯在最后一圈未能提升成绩。
不过第三名在最后时刻发生变化，安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔——落后这位意大利车手59分——跑出1分13秒074，比第四名的汉密尔顿快0.065秒。
勒克莱尔以落后0.289秒的成绩位列前五，而第六名的皮亚斯特里差距较大，这位澳大利亚车手的1分13秒608使他落后安东内利0.659秒。
因此前三支车队——梅赛德斯、法拉利和迈凯伦——照常占据了前六名，而第七名属于奥迪的霍肯伯格，他令人印象深刻地在后期用中性胎跑出1分13秒784。
队友加布里埃尔·博托莱托采取了类似策略，后期跑出1分13秒992，最终排名第九，阿尔派的皮埃尔·加斯利以1分13秒911的硬胎成绩夹在两人之间。

这位四届世界冠军于周四宣布续约，他报告了降挡和转向过度的问题，并在进入最后一个弯道时冲出赛道。
冲刺排位赛将于周五下午进行。
detailEn: F1 Dutch GP: Antonelli pips Norris in practice amid poor showing for Red Bull
The F1 championship leader topped the sole practice session upon returning from the summer break at the Dutch GP
Kimi Antonelli was fastest in practice for the Dutch Grand Prix as the championship leader picked up where he left off upon Formula 1’s return from its summer break.
The Mercedes star set a 1m12.949s lap at Zandvoort and was the only driver to go sub-1m13s as second-place went to McLaren’s reigning world champion Lando Norris with a 1m13.070s.
Drivers were quick to head out for the sole practice session of this sprint weekend - one where Zandvoort bids farewell to F1 - with intermediates the initial choice on a damp seaside track.
But conditions were drying, Nico Hulkenberg saying “I think it’s slicks” almost instantly, so it didn’t take long to ditch the intermediates with Oscar Piastri using mediums five minutes in.
The McLaren driver set the pace on a 1m23.311s, 2.251s quicker than Lewis Hamilton who was fastest on intermediates, before reducing that to a 1m20.480s with his next lap.
That drastic improvement was a sign of things to come on the evolving surface as Antonelli surged to the top with a 1m18.264s, 1m16.112s and then a 1m15.531s on his opening three tours.

So the lap times kept tumbling, Hamilton, George Russell and Charles Leclerc all greeted the top of the leaderboard, while Antonelli also endured a 360-degree spin at Turn 10 halfway through the one-hour session. “I don’t know what the heck happened there,” reported the Mercedes driver.
Everything naturally ramped up when the soft tyre runs commenced with 10 minutes remaining and Piastri was first to beat Leclerc’s medium benchmark (1m14.146s) by setting a 1m13.608s.
Piastri wasn’t fastest for long though as Leclerc regained top spot by 0.261s, before a 1m13.139s lap for Ferrari team-mate Hamilton put him 0.208s quicker.
But there was yet more change in the final five minutes on a busy circuit as Norris went quickest with a 1m13.105s, subsequently beaten by Antonelli who was 0.156s faster.
That was enough for the championship leader, who holds a 50-point advantage over runner-up Hamilton, to remain top as Norris failed to improve on his final lap.
There was a late change for third though, as Antonelli’s team-mate George Russell - who is 59 points behind the Italian - set a 1m13.074s to go 0.065s quicker than fourth-placed Hamilton.
Leclerc rounded out the top five with a lap that was 0.289s off the pace and it was a big gap to Piastri in sixth as the Australian’s 1m13.608s put him 0.659s behind Antonelli.
So the top three teams - Mercedes, Ferrari and McLaren - occupied the first six spots as usual, whereas seventh went to Audi’s Hulkenberg who impressively set a 1m13.784s with the mediums late on.
Team-mate Gabriel Bortoleto opted for a similar strategy with a 1m13.992s late on and he finished ninth, with Alpine’s Pierre Gasly splitting the pair after setting a 1m13.911s on hards.
Racing Bulls rookie Arvid Lindblad (1m14.285s) completed the top 10 in a poor session for Red Bull, who respectively finished 11th and 14th via Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar’s stand-in Liam Lawson.
The four-time world champion, who on Thursday announced his contract renewal, reported problems with downshifts and oversteer and had an off heading into the final corner.
Sprint qualifying is up next on Friday afternoon.

detailZh: 安德烈亚·基米·安东内利在荷兰大奖赛唯一一次练习赛中领跑。
匈牙利大奖赛冠军兰多·诺里斯在赞德福特这一小时练习赛结束时，夹在两位梅赛德斯车手之间，位列第二。
练习赛开始前下雨，赛道潮湿但逐渐变干。尽管最先上场的车手使用了半雨胎，他们很快认定赛道已适合干胎。
安东内利是领先车手中第一个做出有竞争力圈速的人。梅赛德斯和法拉利车手在较硬轮胎上交替做出最快圈速。
车手们在还剩10分钟时换上软胎，以模拟排位赛。法拉利车手一度领先，随后诺里斯以微弱优势超过刘易斯·汉密尔顿。
安东内利第一次尝试排位赛模拟圈时，在圈中遇到尼科·霍肯伯格的奥迪，因而受到影响。不过他的软胎证明还能再跑一圈，这位世界锦标赛领先者随即跑进1分13秒以内，做出1分12秒949的最快圈速。
无人能与之匹敌。诺里斯也提升了自己的成绩，但最终落后安东内利0.1秒，仅以0.004秒领先另一位梅赛德斯车手乔治·拉塞尔。
接下来是两位法拉利车手，随后是另一位迈凯伦车手奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里。两辆红牛均未进入前十，马克斯·维斯塔潘受转向过度困扰，做出第11快圈速。
利亚姆·劳森回归红牛后比马克斯·维斯塔潘慢0.5秒。伊萨克·哈贾尔——劳森暂时接替了他的席位——在练习赛期间带着受伤的手腕出现在赛道。
奥迪再次展现强劲速度，尼科·霍肯伯格做出第七快圈速。他与队友之间隔着皮埃尔·加斯利，后者是本周唯一受益于阿尔派升级套件的阿尔派车手。
阿尔维德·林德布拉德位列第十，比另一位重返赛场的角田裕毅快0.9秒。本田的新动力单元帮助费尔南多·阿隆索在成绩表上位列维斯塔潘之后，排名第12。
威廉姆斯车手小卡洛斯·塞恩斯在练习赛结束时排名最慢。他三次冲出赛道：两次在汉斯·恩斯特弯，一次在13号弯。

detailEn: Andrea Kimi Antonelli headed the sole practice session for the Dutch Grand Prix.
Hungarian Grand Prix winner Lando Norris split the two Mercedes drivers at the top of the times at the end of the single hour of running at Zandvoort.
Rain before the session began left the track damp but drying as the session started. Although the first drivers to join the track used intermediate tyres they quickly decided it was ready for slicks.
Antonelli was the first of the front-runners to set a competitive time. The Mercedes and Ferrari drivers exchanged the quickest times on the harder rubber.
Drivers switched to the soft tyres with 10 minutes to go in order to simulate their qualifying runs. The Ferrari drivers briefly led the way, then Norris narrowly beat Lewis Hamilton.

Antonelli’s first attempt at a qualifying run was spoiled when he encountered Nico Hulkenberg’s Audi during his lap. However his soft rubber proved capable of performing another run and the world championship leader duly dipped under the 1’13 mark, setting a best time of 1’12.949.
No one else could match that. Norris also improved his time but ended up a tenth of a second behind Antonelli, leading the other Mercedes of George Russell by a mere four thousandths of a second.
The Ferrari pair came next, followed by Oscar Piastri in the other McLaren. Neither Red Bull appeared in the top 10, Max Verstappen struggling with oversteer on his way to the 11th-fastest time.

Liam Lawson was half a second slower than Max Verstappen on his return to Red Bull. Isack Hadjar, whose seat Lawson has temporarily taken over, appeared at the track with his injured wrist during the session.

Audi showed strong pace again, Nico Hulkenberg setting the seventh fastest time. He was separated from his team mate by Pierre Gasly, who is the only Alpine driver to benefit from the team’s upgrade package this weekend.

Arvid Lindblad completed the top 10, nine-tenths of a second quicker than the returning Yuki Tsunoda in the other Racing Bulls. Honda’s new power unit helped Fernando Alonso to 12th in the times sheets behind Verstappen.
Williams driver Carlos Sainz Jnr ended the session slowest. He went off three times: twice at Hans Ernst and once at turn 13.

items.summaryZh: 前F1车手乔利恩·帕尔默认为，埃斯特班·奥康与哈斯车队关系紧张，其在车队的未来"真的麻烦了"。随着维斯塔潘承诺留红牛至2030年底、塞恩斯和阿尔本与威廉姆斯续约，2027年车手阵容逐渐成形，奥康的席位受到质疑。

items.summaryEn: Former F1 driver Jolyon Palmer believes Esteban Ocon is "really in trouble" at Haas amid a strained relationship with the team. As the 2027 grid takes shape following Verstappen's commitment to Red Bull and Sainz and Albon's contract extensions with Williams, Ocon's seat is being questioned.
detailZh: 乔利恩·帕尔默对埃斯特班·奥孔在哈斯F1车队的未来表示怀疑：“真的陷入了困境”
乔利恩·帕尔默认为，随着外界对这位法国车手F1未来的质疑不断增多，埃斯特班·奥孔在哈斯“真的陷入了困境”。
前F1车手乔利恩·帕尔默认为，鉴于奥孔与这支美国车队之间“关系紧张”，他“真的陷入了困境”，他在哈斯的未来成了问题。
在马克斯·维斯塔潘承诺留在红牛直到2030年底，以及卡洛斯·塞恩斯和亚历克斯·阿尔本都与威廉姆斯续约之后，2027年的F1车手阵容开始逐渐成形。因此，围场内的注意力已转向剩下的中游车队空缺席位，奥孔在哈斯的席位正受到质疑。
在荷兰大奖赛周末之前，帕尔默在F1 TV的《周末热身》节目中发言，对这位法国人在哈斯车队的前景表示怀疑。
"我认为埃斯特班现在真的陷入了麻烦," 帕尔默解释道。"他与哈斯的关系现在有些紧张。他的表现不佳，而那可是个重要的席位。"
与帕尔默一起参加节目的亚历克斯·布伦德尔也表示："是的，埃斯特班的席位是那个有待讨论的席位。会不会是去年F2冠军莱昂纳多·福尔纳罗利？会不会是与法拉利有关联的拉斐尔·卡马拉坐上那个席位，还是说奥孔会保住它？"
奥孔于2025年加入哈斯。在他效力该队的首个赛季中，他的表现被新秀队友奥利弗·比尔曼超越。比尔曼以41分在车手积分榜上排名年度第13位，而奥孔则以38分排名第15位。
对这位29岁的车手来说不幸的是，这种表现差距延续到了2026年。在前11轮比赛过后，Bearman以18分位居车手积分榜第13位，而Ocon仅积3分排名第17位。
Ocon在夏休期前谈到了自己的合同问题，确认当时没有任何可宣布的消息，但暗示谈判可能会在8月进行。
“当然，目前还没有什么可宣布的，”他说，“夏休期会相当忙碌。我们拭目以待。现在我们专注于这场比赛，之后再看看会发生什么。”
“总是有很多选择。目前我们会先与车队进行讨论。我来到这里已经两年了。当初是Ayao [Komatsu]说服我来到这里的。第一次讨论肯定会与这支车队进行。”
detailEn: Jolyon Palmer casts doubt on Esteban Ocon's Haas F1 future: "Really in trouble"
Jolyon Palmer believes Esteban Ocon is “really in trouble” at Haas as questions grow over the Frenchman’s Formula 1 future.
Former Formula 1 driver Jolyon Palmer believes Esteban Ocon is "really in trouble" regarding his future at Haas amid a "strained relationship" with the American squad.

The 2027 F1 grid is beginning to take shape after Max Verstappen committed to Red Bull until the end of 2030 and both Carlos Sainz and Alex Albon signed contract extensions with Williams. Consequently, the paddock's focus has shifted to the remaining midfield vacancies, with Ocon's seat at Haas being questioned.
Speaking on the F1 TV Weekend Warm-Up broadcast ahead of the Dutch Grand Prix weekend, Palmer cast doubt on the Frenchman's future with Haas.
"I think Esteban is really in trouble," Palmer explained. "He's had a bit of a strained relationship now with Haas. He's not performed and that's the big seat."

Alex Brundle, who joined Palmer on the show, also said: "Yeah, Esteban's seat is the one that's up for discussion. Could it be Leonardo Fornaroli, who was Formula 2 champion last year? Could it be the Ferrari-associated Rafael Camara in that seat, or indeed will Ocon keep it?"

Ocon joined Haas in 2025. In his first season with the team, he was outperformed by his rookie team-mate Oliver Bearman. While Bearman finished the year 13th in the drivers' standings with 41 points, Ocon was 15th with 38 points.

Unfortunately for the 29-year-old, this performance deficit has continued into 2026. After the first 11 rounds, Bearman sits 13th in the drivers' championship with 18 points and Ocon is 17th with just three points.
Ocon spoke about his contract ahead of the summer break, confirming that there was nothing to announce at that time but hinting that discussions would likely take place during August.
"Of course nothing to announce yet," he said. "The summer break will be quite busy. We will see. At the moment we're focused on this race and we'll see what happens.

"There's always many options. At the moment we will discuss with the team first. I've been here for two years. I've been convinced by Ayao [Komatsu] to come here. The first discussion will happen with this team for sure."

items.titleZh: 迈凯伦褶皱式尾翼亮相荷兰大奖赛F1升级套件
items.summaryZh: 在F1荷兰大奖赛前夕，迈凯伦推出最新尾翼升级，其引人注目的褶皱式端板设计成为围场内的焦点。

media.altZh: 迈凯伦褶皱式尾翼亮相荷兰大奖赛F1升级套件

items.originalTitle: 迈凯伦褶皱式尾翼亮相荷兰大奖赛F1升级套件
items.summaryEn: Ahead of the Formula 1 Dutch Grand Prix, McLaren's latest rear wing upgrade has drawn attention thanks to its striking rippled endplate design, which has become a focal point in the paddock.
detailZh: 迈凯伦最新的尾翼升级在荷兰大奖赛前就引起了一些关注，这要归功于其引人注目的端板设计。
该研发套件的第一部分已在匈牙利首次亮相，第二部分则包括一副新尾翼、经过修改的中央车身以及调整过的后刹车导流管。
这三个方面都旨在更好地控制赛车后部的气流以提升下压力，但正是尾翼方案把水平提升到了新的高度。
带波纹的端板拥有多条压筋线，比迈凯伦本赛季迄今为止使用过的任何设计都更进一步。
这些波纹的设计目的是帮助更好地控制从后轮胎流出的气流，以及它随后对翼尖处涡流产生的影响。
在尾翼端板上使用这种压痕线条的趋势始于2023年，当时阿尔派和阿斯顿·马丁在摩纳哥大奖赛上同时带来了类似方案，随后其他车队纷纷效仿。
迈凯伦的最新概念比以往更进一步，因为这一区域的端板厚度受到规则的严格限制，可发挥的空间本就很小。
因此，像迈凯伦这样的设计必须相当精巧，同时在结构上也要足够坚固，以承受尾翼所承受的巨大空气动力载荷。
很有意思的是，可以看到迈凯伦在尾翼端板外表面上加装了大量导流叶片（转向叶片）。
这些叶片有助于梳理来自后刹车导管上导流叶片的气流，进而提升扩散器的性能。
让整个车尾作为一个整体协同工作，对赛车整体空气动力学性能至关重要。
阿斯顿·马丁对它在匈牙利大奖赛上带来的新前翼概念进行了调整。
最外侧的末端翼片采用了缩减的弦长，同时内侧底板也进行了升级。
车队还可以选择加装新的前翼襟翼，以便在需要时提供更宽的调节范围来平衡赛车。
阿斯顿·马丁还引入了经过修改的底板导向叶片（floor fences），并对扩散器小翼进行了改动。
法拉利也为赛车引入了一些底板升级，目的是通过让经过调整的后扩散器获得更充沛的气流，在全速度范围内增加下压力。
这些改进包括更新后的底板支撑布局和导流叶片布置，它们与修改后的扩散器和调整过的尾翼主翼（beam wing）协同工作。
阿尔派（阿尔派）的重大升级已经出现在皮埃尔·加斯利（加斯利）在赞德沃特（Zandvoort）的赛车上，队友弗兰科·科拉平托（科拉平托）预计将在下一站意大利大奖赛上用上这套升级。
这些改动集中在底板区域，包括新的底板主体、重新设计的底板侧板、微调的底板边缘以及重新设计的扩散器。
所有这些调整，再加上新的侧箱车身和新的后刹车鼓设计，目的都是增加下压力并改善气流质量。
车队本赛季一直受到高速行驶时平衡性问题的困扰。
科拉平托的旧规格阿尔派赛车在展示环节中亮相，这意味着我们还没能仔细看到升级部件。
detailEn: McLaren’s latest rear wing upgrade raised some eyebrows ahead of Formula 1's Dutch Grand Prix thanks to a striking endplate solution.
The second part of a development package that first arrived in Hungary has included a new rear wing, revised central bodywork and tweaked rear brake ducts.
All three areas are aimed at manipulating the airflow better at the rear of the car for improved downforce, but it is the wing solution that has taken things to a new level.
The rippled endplate features multiple swage lines and is a step beyond what McLaren has run so far this season.
The idea of the ripples is to help better control the airflow coming off the rear tyre and the impact it then has on the vortex at the tip of the wing.
The trend for such swage lines on the rear wing endplates was started in 2023, with Alpine and Aston Martin bringing solutions simultaneously to the Monaco Grand Prix before other teams copied it.
McLaren’s latest concept pushes the boundaries more than before in an area of the car that is quite heavily restricted by regulations that limit endplate thickness.
So, designs like McLaren's have to be quite intricate but also structurally robust enough to withstand the high aerodynamic forces that rear wings are exposed to.
It's interesting to see the extent of turning vanes that McLaren have added to the outer surface of the rear wing end plates.
These vanes help the airflow that is coming off the turning vanes on the rear brake ducts, which in turn helps the performance of the diffuser.
Getting that complete rear end to work as one is critical to the overall performance of the car aerodynamically.
Aston Martin has made adjustments to the new front wing concept that it brought to the Hungarian Grand Prix.
There is a reduced chord to the final outboard elements as well as an upgraded inboard foot.
The team also has the option of fitting a new front wing flap to help give it a wider range of options to balance the car should it be needed.
Aston Martin has also introduced revised floor fences and a modification to its diffuser winglet.
Ferrari has also introduced some floor upgrades to its car that are aimed at increasing downforce across all speed ranges thanks to a more energised flow to a tweaked rear diffuser.
The revisions include an updated board brace layout and vane arrangement and they work in conjunction with the changed diffuser and altered beam wing.
Alpine’s major upgrade has appeared on Pierre Gasly’s car at Zandvoort, with team-mate Franco Colapinto due to get it for the next race in Italy.
The changes focus on the floor area, with a new floor body, reprofiled floor boards, a tweaked floor edge and a reprofiled diffuser.
All the tweaks, which are boosted by new sidepod bodywork and a new rear brake drum design, are aimed at increasing downforce and improving flow quality.
The squad has struggled with a high-speed imbalance problem this season.
Colapinto's older-spec Alpine was on display during the show-and-tell session, meaning we're yet to get a detailed look at the upgrades.
keyPointsZh: 该升级套件是匈牙利大奖赛首次引入的升级的第二部分，还包括修改后的中央车身和微调的后刹车导管。
三处改进均旨在更好地控制赛车尾部气流，以提升下压力。
褶皱式端板拥有多条压痕线，超越了迈凯伦本赛季此前使用过的任何方案。

All three areas are aimed at better manipulating the airflow at the rear of the car for improved downforce.
